entries.name: Up The Wall
entries.shortDescription:
Welcome to UP THE WALL by MissMachoTV
Similar to side swipe, this goal is in the upper center of the wall! To add a little extra weirdness, the map is also turned 90 degrees so it is wider instead of longer. All boost pads are also turned with the rest of the field. Lets see how that throws off normal rotations!

Personal note: This map was a requestest to be turned 90 degrees and I must say, it really throws me off! ~(^-^~)

Mutators: None. It's a standard map.


Discord: MissMacho

entries.shortDescription:

A Plat's dream and SSL's nightmare! No need to protect the goal from ariels because they wont be going in! Have fun with this extra wide goal that is HALF the height of a normal goal, forcing more ground play and less flicks!

Personal note: This is the 3rd and potentially final map of 'THE ONE' set of maps! ~(^-^~)

Mutators: None. It's a standard map.

Personal note: Mix it up and see what works for you! There are so many ways to play this map! (^-^)

entries.name: The Real Boomer Mode
entries.shortDescription:
This is a multiplayer stadium. Play with your friends either 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, or 4v4.

EVERYBODY needs Bakkesmod Net Code Plugin (#166) in order to BOOM.

Press the "Use Item" button to BOOM. BOOM next to the ball. BOOM next to other players.

Recommended game settings:

Respawn Time - 1 second

Also try boomer mode settings for more fun.

My personal favorite was heavy ball.

entries.name: Portal Floor Stadium
entries.shortDescription:
*Host will need Map Expansion Plugin for map to work!!!* (#294)

First team to score 30 goals wins.

Use the following settings when playing this map.

Match Length - Unlimited
Boost Amount - Unlimited

Feel free to use any other mutators that you want, my personal favorite is Boomer mode settings with super fast ball speed.

Shout out to SimpleShark for reviewing my Kismet and optimizing it.

entries.name: Fetch
entries.shortDescription:
Dog is man's best friend. You're the dog... Fetch!

The dog owner rewards you for bringing the ball back, especially if you did all the work.

Game Rules
- Both teams are trying to score on the same net.
- Last team to touch the ball scores.
- Scoring is based on your team's possession time. (75% of possession time == 75 points)
- The Map Expansion Plugin is required.

Settings
- Unlimited Boost

Notes
- The host has a scoreboard that shows score, possession time, possession per...

entries.shortDescription:
This is my very first map creation. I was testing models and the basics of Rocket League custom maps. There are 3 goals on each side of the field, and that’s all there is to it! The ball MAY disappear randomly… Did I mention this was my first creation ever?

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Giant Foosball Table
entries.shortDescription:
This map takes Standard Rocket League and places it on regular foosball table!. Scoring is just like normal, except the ball has to fall into the floor of the goal! The figures on each teams’ side can get in the way, causing some unique moments.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Speed: Fast
Ball Physics: Light
Ball Bounciness: High

entries.name: Air Hockey Table
entries.shortDescription:
The puck (or ball) spawns on top of the bridge, and there is a barrier between the two halves of the map to divide players. If you shoot the puck (or ball) through the underpass, the velocity of the puck will be boosted! I plan on recreating this map in a polished, proper air hockey style!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Type: Puck
Ball Size: Large
Ball Bounciness: Low

entries.name: Giant Pinball Table
entries.shortDescription:
Insert the ball into the coin slot to start the game. Use your car to control the flippers and launch the ball. See how high of a score you can get!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Break the Bank
entries.shortDescription:
Collect points by getting the ball through your colored rings and bring the ball to your color's bank! If a goal is scored, the collections reset. At the moment, it's set to first to 100, but set whatever points you want as a cap.

Recommended Settings
Boost Amount: Unlimited
Spike rush is not required but is a lot of fun!

entries.name: Beer Pong
entries.shortDescription:
This map brings the classic game of Beer Pong into Rocket League. There are 6 cups for each team, score on all 6 to win the game! There is a giant cup portal at the back of the map that takes you to the other side of the field. Drink responsibly.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost Amount: Unlimited

entries.name: Prop Hunt
entries.shortDescription:
Disguise your car as a prop and try to avoid getting caught!

This map is the first prop hunt map I created. You can choose a variety of medieval props to hide on 4 different floors of the castle. Once you get caught, you swap teams and help find the rest of the props!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Demo: On Contact

entries.name: Ping Pong Table
entries.shortDescription:
This was one of my first attempts at custom models and importing them into Rocket League. This ping pong table has goals around the outside border, and can lead to a lot of chaos. Feel free to play by your own rules.

(stay on your own side, for example, or one hit per player)

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Ball Max Speed: Fast
Ball Physics: Curveball
Ball Bounciness: High
Boost: Unlimited
Boost Strength: 1.5x
Gravity: Low

entries.name: Water Polo
entries.shortDescription:
This map was originally created by Glhglh, but I remastered it to work in the current state of the game. The goals are suspended halfway up the sides of the field at a waterline. The ball and cars will float in the water, so prepare to lose control of your car as you bounce around the field!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Feel free to experiment with other settings like boomer!

entries.name: Pool Table
entries.shortDescription:
This map is currently broken, but feel free to explore the map and see how it all works!
The original map worked by shooting the cue ball into the group of pool balls, and the scoreboard would keep track of sunk balls. You could also reset the cue ball in the kitchen if the white ball dropped!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Battlegrounds
entries.shortDescription:
Welcome to the battlegrounds! This map is 7 nearly-standard maps glued together. Probably one of the funniest maps I’ve created, even though it’s quite glitchy at the intersections of each map. You may find yourself getting sucked through a wall here or there, but it’s worth it.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: First to 1 Goal
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Shipment
entries.shortDescription:
I brought Call of Duty into Rocket League by recreating the Shipment map we all know and love! The goals are inside the open shipping containers on each team’s side.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Max Speed: Fast
Ball Physics: Light
Ball Bounciness: High

entries.name: Portal
entries.shortDescription:
Play in a Portal-style map with portals that connect to each side of the room!

The goals are the giant doors on each side of the map. I plan on making a second version of this in the future as I revisit older maps. Enjoy!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Boardwalk
entries.shortDescription:
The goals of this map are atop a boardwalk that splits off in 4 ways in the center. This map was built from the skeleton of my Water Polo map, and I created a series of boards to drive across and mess around.

Warning: Don’t smash into the boardwalk too hard, you might just break it ;)

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer can be fun!

entries.name: Dribbling Challenge 1
entries.shortDescription:
This map was my first attempt at making a dribbling challenge. I purposely made this one very difficult to elevate the difficulty of dribbling challenges out there.

There are 30 levels in total, which increase in difficulty substantially as the levels go on. Enter at your own risk!

Recommended Settings
Enter in Freeplay!

entries.name: Block Fort
entries.shortDescription:
Block Fort was an original Mario Kart 64 Battle Arena, and I brought it into Rocket League! Each block fort has a cube goal on top, feel free to play free for all on this map, or team sides with yellow and red vs green and blue.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Score Limit: Your choice!
Playing with lives is very fun

entries.name: 2Fort
entries.shortDescription:
2Fort is a map from Team Fortress 2, and it’s HUGE! This map is made up of nearly 3000 models I had to individually import and texture, and took me around 300 hours to finish. With this in mind, the map is nearly 1GB in size and can cause crashes occasionally, but it’s still one of my favorite Hide n Seek maps to date. 

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Time: Unlimited

entries.name: Christmas Snow Hill
entries.shortDescription:
I created this map for 2019 Christmas, taking a ski-hill design and creating a sloped standard Rocket League field. The most difficult part to make in this map was the outer detail. Definitely one of the brighter and cheerier maps I’ve created!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Basketball Court
entries.shortDescription:
This basketball court features 3 basketball nets on each team, elevated from the floor. The outer nets grant you 2 points per goal! Be careful not to get stuck in the rafters, or on the balcony!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Time: Unlimited
Rumble or Boomer (why not both?) is also quite fun!

entries.name: Original Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
This is the first of many Sumo maps I’ve created! This map is a simple sumo map with a single circular platform to battle with your friends! Be the last one standing! Team battles are also quite fun. We usually give points equal to the number of players left on a team that survived. Go to whatever point cap you want!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Recharge Slow
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Bouncy Castle
entries.shortDescription:
Rocket League inside a bouncy castle! There are 4 goals in each quadrant of the map, and the floor is quite bumpy. Using Rocket Plugin (Bakkesmod), you can change the floor friction values to simulate a bouncy floor.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Type: Beachball
Ball Max Speed: Fast
Ball Physics: Light
Ball Bounciness: High

entries.name: Rainbow Road 64
entries.shortDescription:
Rainbow Road 64 brought to life inside Rocket League! This is the first race map I’ve created. These are models ripped from the N64 game and imported into a map that works for Rocket League. Be careful not to fall off the map! I didn’t have checkpoints in this map quite yet.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Up to you!
Time: Unlimited

entries.name: Underwater Goals
entries.shortDescription:
This map is difficult. That is all.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Time: Unlimited
You may want Boomer or Rumble!

entries.name: Easter Catwalk
entries.shortDescription:
This map was created for Easter of 2019, collaborated by myself and Glhglh, a well-known map maker! This map has 2 goals on top of a catwalk in the center of the field, and the outer sides of the field have boost in the grass. How many golden eggs can you spot outside the field?

Recommended Settings
None

entries.name: Gladiator
entries.shortDescription:
Gladiator is a unique form of Tug of War, where you battle against the opponent to push the ball through the rings and score in the final goal at the back of the field. The white rings don’t do anything, only the blue and orange rings push the goal further away!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Time: Unlimited
Rumble, Boomer, or Spike Rush are also fun!

entries.name: Minecraft
entries.shortDescription:
Bring Minecraft and Rocket League together in giant map of a Minecraft town. This map can be played as either a Standard map or Hide n Seek. You can hide anywhere in the map, including inside the houses, lighthouses, or even underwater!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited (Hide and Seek)
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Luigis Mansion
entries.shortDescription:
Luigi’s Mansion is an old race track from the Mario Kart series! This map is great as a race map in 2 different ways. Either as a driving race, or using the Ghost Hunt balls to try and push your ball around the racetrack first! This can get quite competitive!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Type: Ghost Hunt

entries.name: Pyramids
entries.shortDescription:
A standard field hidden away in the Rocket League desert, this map features bumpy sand dunes with pyramids scattered inside a giant map! Try to keep control of your car in the air, and avoid getting stuck on the ground!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer and Rumble are great on this map!

entries.name: The Floor is Lava
entries.shortDescription:
The second Sumo map of the series! This time the standard field has been overrun by lava and you have to avoid falling in. Feel free to play Free for All or Team Deathmatch, last team standing wins!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Recharge Fast
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Pitch Black
entries.shortDescription:
Rocket League but everything except the ball and cars is completely invisible! Try not to get lost. The ball color definitely helps keep an idea of where the ball is in the field.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Shuffleboard
entries.shortDescription:
Play shuffleboard with your friends in Rocket League! Spawn in the puck and slide it down the track to try and score as many points as you can! Feel free to make up your own rules to make it more fun for your group.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Type: Puck

entries.name: Mayan Pitz
entries.shortDescription:
Designed after an old historic game with rings on the wall. Score through the rings with the ball to win! This game was in Road to El Dorado, one of my favorite cartoon movies as a kid!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Foosball Table 2.0
entries.shortDescription:
REMASTERED VERSION:

This map takes Standard Rocket League and places it on regular foosball table!. Scoring is just like normal, except the ball has to fall into the floor of the goal! The figures on each teams’ side can get in the way, causing some unique moments.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer is also quite fun!

entries.name: Ice Rings
entries.shortDescription:
Learn how to aerial like a pro inside a giant 20-level course of aerial navigation. The rings get smaller as you go through the levels, try for a personal best!

Recommended Settings
Freeplay

entries.name: Squash Court
entries.shortDescription:
Play Squash with a Rocket League ball! The court is to scale, and plays out just like the game in real life. Serve above the middle red line, and the possession changes when the ball hits the back wall. A ball is out if it touches any yellow parts of the wall! 1 bounce is allowed before a player or team loses the round.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Physics: Light
Goal Reset: Disabled

entries.name: Skyscraper
entries.shortDescription:
Another classic battle map from Mario Kart 64, turned into a standard map in Rocket League! The 4 goals are in the colored openings of the skyscraper. You can come up with your own game modes or play free for all with 4 different colors!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer ball is also quite fun!

entries.name: 4-Square
entries.shortDescription:
A childhood favorite during recess, 4-square is here in Rocket League! The ball has to fall below the floor to score, feel free to keep tally of individual points or cycle around with a king of the hill!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Physics: Light
Do unlimited time if you’re doing lives or king of the hill.

entries.name: Warios Goldmine
entries.shortDescription:
The most detailed Mario Kart map brought into Rocket League so far: this map was extremely difficult to bring to life, and I had to create custom collision for the track given the nature of the bumpy models. Using custom demo derby rumble items on this map is insanely fun!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited

entries.name: Heatseeker Dungeon
entries.shortDescription:
A standard map with a re-colored Heatseeker ball! I had this as a game mode before Rocket League officially put Heatseeker in as a mutator. Enjoy playing Heatseeker in a different environment!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Heatseeker Tennis
entries.shortDescription:
Heatseeker with a twist! The net in the center of the map can really cause some trouble for either your opponent or yourself! Be careful if the ball hits the net because the ball will punish you! A ton of fun in any team size.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Tetherball
entries.shortDescription:
I finally got Tetherball in Rocket League to work, and it’s amazing! The heatseeker ball swings around the center pole, and the goals are on the outer edges of the circular field! Get the proper angle and power or cheat up on the other side of the field! 

Huge thanks to glhglh and Cinderblock for help getting this to work!

Recommended Settings
REQUIRED: Plugin - https://bakkesplugins.com/plugins/view/101


Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Miniature Pool Table
entries.shortDescription:
A top-down Rocket League racer inside a classic style arcade. Honestly one of my favorite maps in terms of visual aesthetic, I really love the mood of this one. The race track has a couple shortcuts and MANY ways to get stuck! So be careful as you race around the map!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Hoops Stadium
entries.shortDescription:
Hoops meets Throwback stadium! I’ve created 2 bowls and placed them inside an oval-shaped Rocket League field. The map is exactly what you’d expect: score in the bowl to win the game! A lot of fun in any team size, so go for it!

Recommended Settings
Game Mode: Hoops
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Fashion Show
entries.shortDescription:
Show off your car in this unique fashion show room! This was a map I made for BlackWidow for her fashion show. This map could be used for a deathmatch!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Lava Rings
entries.shortDescription:
Re-textured Ice Rings:

Learn how to aerial like a pro inside a giant 20-level course of aerial navigation. The rings get smaller as you go through the levels, try for a personal best!

Recommended Settings
Freeplay

entries.name: Star Wars
entries.shortDescription:
Do I need to say more? I created a Star Wars themed Standard Map! You’re located inside a hangar of a Star Destroyer. In the distance you can see the Death Star doing what it does best…

Recommended Settings

entries.name: Airship
entries.shortDescription:
This is the third installment of the Sumo Series, this time with fans that launch you into the air! There are elevated platforms that you can hide away and collect boost, but be careful of falling off!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Spaceship
entries.shortDescription:
Explore the depths of an abandoned Spaceship, or hide with your friends! This map is gigantic, so I’ve provided 2 versions to help with peoples’ PCs if they find the full version reduces framerate.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Hospital
entries.shortDescription:
Welcome to the Rocket League Hospital! One of the biggest Hide and Seek maps to date, there are plenty of unique ways to hide your car from the seekers. Storage containers, cranes, cars, crates, and more! The hospital is in the center of the map but there is much more to this place.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Prop Hunt Remastered
entries.shortDescription:
UPDATED VERSION OF PROP HUNT:

Disguise your car as a prop and try to avoid getting caught!

This map is the first prop hunt map I created. You can choose a variety of medieval props to hide on 4 different floors of the castle. Once you get caught, you swap teams and help find the rest of the props!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Demo: On Contact

entries.name: Water Polo Remastered
entries.shortDescription:
UPDATED VERSION OF WATER POLO:

This map was originally created by Glhglh, but I remastered it to work in the current state of the game. The goals are suspended halfway up the sides of the field at a waterline. The ball and cars will float in the water, so prepare to lose control of your car as you bounce around the field!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Feel free to experiment with other settings like boomer!

entries.name: Rapid Fire
entries.shortDescription:
Inspired by Hungry Hungry Hippos, I created a 4-player (or 2-team) ball collection game mode! There are 3 different ball types:
Standard Ball: 1 Point
Dropshot Ball: 2 Points
Heatseeker Ball: 5 Points
Score the most before the time runs out!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Spike Rush is very fun on this map!

entries.name: Forest
entries.shortDescription:
Description
I created this map to help Mr. Beast with his #TeamTrees project last year to plant 20 million trees! This map is an interpretation of a standard map overrun by the environment, and has some quirky features inside that make controlling the ball… uh… well, difficult.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer ball is also quite fun!

entries.name: Volcanic Eruption
entries.shortDescription:
Description
The fourth edition of my Rocket League Sumo series! This time around, beware of the active volcano that will erupt at random moments, sending every player high into the sky! Make sure to save enough boost to recover and avoid being bumped mid-air!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Recharge Fast

entries.name: Beach Brawl
entries.shortDescription:
Description
I took Water Polo and the Rocket League Throwback Stadium and put them together into a mash-up of land and water gameplay! The goals are at the edges of the water pool. I suggest using Rumble but it’s not necessary, definitely adds some fun aspects to it though!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Type: Beach Ball

entries.name: Inside Out
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League but it’s inside-out! I put the goals in the middle of the field this time around, which leads to some pretty cool interactions above and around the goals. Very fast-paced action! Definitely on the more polished side of most of my maps.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Standard Dropshot
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Standard Dropshot is probably my most polished map to date. This is the ultimate combination between Standard Rocket League and Dropshot, including both the regular goals, as well as Dropshot tiles along the entire floor. The boost pads exist and float on the floor, but the ball won’t collide with them!

Recommended Settings
Game Mode: Dropshot

entries.name: The Bubble
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Welcome to the Rocket League Bubble, the 5th installment of the Sumo Series! This map features a ring around the outside, with a giant bubble in center floating above. This bubble has zero gravity! Tread carefully, and try not to fall into the water!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Recharge Slow
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Fall Guys
entries.shortDescription:
Description
It may have taken me 300+ hours to make all the models and get the whole map functioning, but it’s finally a reality! Fall Guys in Rocket League. This is Slime Climb from Season 1 of Fall Guys. Play with a bunch of your friends and race to the top! It’s not as easy as it looks.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Disabled
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Dart Board
entries.shortDescription:
Description
The second addition to the Rocket League Arcade, the Rocket League dartboard joins the Pool Table Race as another fun mini game to enjoy with friends! Test your accuracy by spawning in darts (colored balls), and you can clear the board with the push of a button.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Boost Strength: 1.5x

entries.name: Half-Size
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League, but half the size! This map can destroy your brain, but it’s super fun! You can mess with the ball size to make the ball fit to scale, or mess with car scale to try and play at hyper-speed.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Hex Drop
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Hex Drop is the second of Dropshot maps I’ve created! This map is the sister to Inside Out, where dropshot goals are between the H-shaped middle area. There’s a window in the middle for the ball to spawn! Definitely puts a different spin on the classic Dropshot mode.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Score Limit: First to 1 Goal

entries.name: Toronto Track
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Race in Downtown Toronto, my nearby city! There are crates covering the race track, and you can recover boost by running over the boost pads spread across the race.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Rumble: Demolition Derby
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Popshot
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League Dropshot… but on the ceiling instead?! This map was a lot of fun to create, and a lot of fun to play! Pop the ball into the ceiling to open up the tiles, and shoot it into an open tile to score!

Recommended Settings
Game Mode: Dropshot
Slight boomer or rumble can be helpful!

entries.name: Flash Freeze
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Welcome to Rocket League Flash Freeze! Every 15-30 seconds a random flash freeze will occur, stopping the ball’s motion for up to 3 seconds! There’s no moving that ball during that time, so try and time when it’s released!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Helium Ball
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League, but the ball is weightless! Enjoy a ball with zero gravity in my standard dungeon map. This will mess with your brain, gauranteed, but it’s still a lot of fun!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Slight boomer or rumble can be fun!

entries.name: Cargo Bay
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League in space! The ball behaves normally but the cars float in the “air” in the map! This makes it very difficult to control your car, so enjoy as you float around with your friends trying to hit the ball.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Sumo Cagematch
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Technically this is the 6th map to join the Sumo Series of maps, but in this version it’s all about demolitions! Be the last one standing to win. Feel free to experiment with demo on contact, or play a skillful match of full-speed demos!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Recharge Fast
Demo: Friendly Fire (or Contact FF)

entries.name: Grand Hall
entries.shortDescription:
Description
A freestyler’s paradise… Enjoy this non-standard map with pilars around a cylindrical hall! Expect some crazy bounces off the pillars around the edge of the map.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer is very fun on this map!

entries.name: Double-Size
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League, but it’s twice the size! Feel free to experiment with ball size and boomer, expect a long journey back to your goal! This is part 2 to the half-size map I made recently.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer is very fun on this map!

entries.name: Graverobber
entries.shortDescription:
Description
In this spooky Rocket League map, enjoy a bit of a spin-off of standard gameplay with goals that open up in the floor! Score in the standard net to open the opponent’s graves, and score in the open hole to win!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Air Dribble Arena
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is perfect for air dribble practice! The goals are elevated on the backboard, with a ramp in the center that sets you up to carry the ball. This map is unique in the fact that under the net on your side is rather safe.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Spaceseeker
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Heatseeker in space! What more could you want? I created a giant cage to contain this crazy heatseeker ball with zero gravity. Be careful of when the ball goes behind the goal, the ball has a mind of its own. Enjoy!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boost Strength: 2x

entries.name: Capture the Flag
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map has been requested for so long, and it’s finally a reality! Welcome to Rocket League Capture the Flag! Bring the opponent’s ball to your zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Recharge (Slow)
Rumble: Spike Rush

entries.name: Sling Puck
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is based on a real-life board game where you use the elastic to get all of your pucks onto the opponent’s side… So I brought it to life in Rocket League! 5 pucks spawn on each side, be the first to clear all of the pucks to win the round!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Air Hockey Remastered
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Anyone remember my VERY old air hockey map with the underpass in the middle and GIGANTIC goals in the back? Yeah… we don’t talk about that. Here is my brand new air hockey table with a working puck! Choose how fast you want the puck to move by messing with ball mutators!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Physics: Boomer mode is best for fast-paced action

entries.name: Crossroads
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Similar to the old Octagon map, there are 4 goals in the outer edges of the map, but I’ve cut in the sides creating a cross-shape in the map. Quickly change from defense to offense and have quick transitions between sides.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Among Us in Rocket League
entries.shortDescription:
Description
With the help of Gidek and Cinderblock, 2 amazing modders in the community, we have come together to bring a fully working Among Us game inside Rocket League! This took over 1200 hours total to finish, and it works so well. Make sure to download the plugin for Bakkesmod to make the map work with friends.

Recommended Settings
Boost: No Boost
Time: Unlimited
Score: First to 1 Goal (set score when game ends)
Use KBM for this map

Plugin REQUIRED: https://bakkesplugins.com/p...

entries.name: Egyptian Parkour
entries.shortDescription:
Description
I created an entire Egyptian Tomb adventure map inside Rocket League! Beware, as this map is very difficult! Boost is not allowed. The best experience is with friends online. The ankhs are optional, but if you manage to get all 30, something special awaits you…

Recommended Settings
Boost: No Boost
Time: Unlimited
Respawn Time: 1 Second (helps make respawns faster)

entries.name: Block Fort Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League Block Fort, but this time with lava! Challenge your friends to a game of Sumo, and feel free to use demolition derby rumble powerups to make it feel more like balloon battle! We had a lot of fun playing on this one.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Recharge Slow
Demo: Disabled
Rumble: Demolition Derby

entries.name: Cornhole
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Using cube balls in rocket league, I’ve created a brand new game mode in Rocket League based on the game Cornhole! Take turns throwing bean bags onto the board, at the end of all 8 throws, add up points and the team with more points gets the difference in points in score. Bean bags in the hole = 3 points, bean bags on the board = 1. If you scored 5, and the opponents scored 3, you get 2 points. You have to score exactly 11 to win! Going over means you lose those points.

Recomm...

entries.name: Wave Race
entries.shortDescription:
Rocket League racing… on a jetski??? Yep, I finally finished a project I started 2 years ago. This is Rocket League Wave Race, challenge your friends to the most unique race in Rocket League to date, and try not to hit too many barrels! Maneuver your way the best out of your friends to win!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited
Boost Strength: 1.5 or 2x
Demo: Disabled
Rumble can be interesting! Just use Demo Derby mutator

entries.name: Neon Heights Rings
entries.shortDescription: Learn how to aerial like a pro inside my second giant 20-level course of aerial navigation. The rings get smaller as you go through the levels, try for a personal best!

entries.name: Giant Easter Egg
entries.shortDescription: This standard Rocket League map variant was created by my sister, and it features 3 different platforms suspended inside a giant Easter egg! This map is a ton of fun with Boomer or Rumble, and helps with reading strange ball bounces.

entries.name: The Hive
entries.shortDescription: This new game mode was started a year ago by myself, and recently Mr. Swaggles joined me to do a lot of the final details. We worked together for countless hours to create a brand new field that has a unique feel and look. You pair up with teammates in opposite rooms to repair your own team colored room, while stopping the other team from repairing in theirs.

entries.name: Capture the Flag Winter
entries.shortDescription: This map is a re-skin of my first Capture the Flag for Beyond the Summit! Bring the opponent’s ball to your zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach!

entries.name: Split
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map takes standard Rocket League and splits it in half. Since the map is split in half, 2v2 is the minimum game mode for this map, and make sure to disable demos!

Recommended Settings
Team Size: 2v2+
Demos: Disabled

entries.name: Air Hockey 4Team
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This is a variation of the Air Hockey Map I released in the Rocket League arcade, this time with 4 teams! There are corners which push the puck back into play. You decide rules on crossing sides or not! Lives are displayed on screen.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Ball Physics: Boomer mode is best for fast-paced action

entries.name: Floating Rings
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map takes standard Rocket League and puts the rings in the air! Test your skill at accurate power shots, or try your hand at boomer mode with your friends. This map is also quite fun with the football if you load the Gridiron game mode through Rocket Plugin.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer and Rumble are both great

entries.name: Horseshoe
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map was designed by my sister (IamKikira on Twitch) and she created a vertical horseshoe with goals in the very bottom of each end. There are platforms mid-air where the ball and cars spawn on kickoff. Is luck on your side in this map?

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer mode is STRONGLY recommended

entries.name: DFH Cliffside
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League racing, one-way this time! Introducing DFH Cliffside, where it’s a race to the top of the hill. There are pitstops for fun relay races if you want to mix it up, otherwise the fastest to the final tunnel wins!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: Unlimited or Recharge
Demo: Disabled
Rumble can be interesting! Just use Demo Derby

entries.name: The Ring of Fire
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is the first of possibly many inside a brand new Rocket League Circus tent I created. This map features 2 ramps with a ring of fire in the center of the field, hanging from the ceiling. Don’t worry! The flames won’t hurt the cars. Score in the colored end of the ring to score a point for your team.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer mode is pretty fun

entries.name: Slantshot
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League Dropshot… but on the slanted floor this time around! Don’t worry if the ball is completely black, it’s intentional. For “some” reason, Rocket League really doesn’t like Dropshot tiles being on an angle, so I had to do some voodoo magic to make this one work, and the end result is a black ball. But this map is really fun with Boomer mode!

Recommended Settings
Game Mode: Dropshot
Slight boomer or rumble are great!

entries.name: Capture the Flag Sandcastle
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is the second concept of Rocket League Capture the Flag! Bring the opponent’s ball to the top of your castle zone while your ball is home to score a point! Feel free to choose what score to reach!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Recharge (slow or fast)
Rumble: Spike Rush

entries.name: Rocket Labs Revolver
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map was an attempt at making a similar map to Rocket League’s own labs map, Loophole. Definitely one of my favorite projects based on how clean the map is. There are 3 goals (holes in the floor) for each team with a pillar in the center. Score in any of the 3 goals to score points! I’ll be making variations of game modes on this map soon.

Recommended Settings
Standard gameplay works just fine on this map!

entries.name: Infinium Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League Infinium: the newest Sumo map on the block. This time around, there are gravity wells in the center which will make travelling over them quite difficult for you. The gravity is 10x as strong, so be careful trying to escape from your friends when they’re bumping you!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled

entries.name: Hexagon 2v2v2
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map was designed to be a larger 3-team map, intended for 2v2v2. The goals are GIGANTIC, so enjoy as you betray your friends in this large open field. My sister (iamKikira) designed the models for this one!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer mode and Rumble is pretty fun

entries.name: Full-Scale Football Field
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is a 1-to-1 scale of a football field (as much as it can be to scale for these cars…) with field goals and end zones. This map is incredibly fun with a higher number of players, but no matter what team size it’s very satisfying to run the football down this huge open field.

Recommended Settings
Game Mode: Gridiron
Goal Reset: Disabled
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Dual Pinball Tables
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is a 1-to-1 scale of 2 pinball tables connected together. The ball is the exact size a ball would be inside an arcade pinball machine, and this map is as ridiculous as you’d think. Score in the ball return to win! I highly recommend boomer settings/rumble.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer Settings
Rumble: Civilized

entries.name: Broken Bridge
entries.shortDescription:
Description
The Broken Bridge is one of the first maps my sister (iamKikira on Twitch) designed. Originally the map was just the field, but together we came up with an interesting concept and look by incorporating the field into a split bridge. Playing on a slanted surface isn’t the easiest thing, so I recommend boomer settings for this one.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer Settings are very good

entries.name: Beer Pong Remastered
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This map is based on one of my earliest maps in Rocket League. Beer Pong is set up with 6 cups per team, and the objective is to score in each cup once to win the round! You can either take turns shooting at the cups, or play in this map competitively like a standard map. Scoring in the back cups or repeat cups results in a ball reset.

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Volleyshot
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Volleyshot is a combination of Dropshot and Volleyball, where the goal is the same: score in the floor of the opponent’s side. However, in this version of Volleyshot, the wall is removed so you’re free to travel to either side of the field. Think of this map as Dropshot with a wall in the middle. Don’t get caught over-committing!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Score Limit: You choose
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Clock Tower
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Welcome to the Rocket League Clock Tower! This map is a giant re-imagination of the inside of a giant clock tower, with moving gears. The clock ticks to each second, but the gear teeth don’t affect the ball or car to avoid any collision issues. Boomer is super fun on this one!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer Settings are very good

entries.name: Flappy Bird
entries.shortDescription:
Description
I took the classic viral game of Flappy Bird and put it into Rocket League! Enabled “unlimited flips” in Bakkesmod freeplay settings, and try your best to clear pipes as long as you can by using the unlimited jumps. Try either 1st Person or 3rd Person below!

Recommended Settings
Freeplay

entries.name: Mario Bros
entries.shortDescription:
Description
I took the classic Mario Bros. game and stuck it inside Rocket League! Playing in a 2D platformer in a 3D game isn’t the most elegant, but I did my best to make the game feel like the original. You can hit the POW to send the players and ball up in the air. The top pipes are 3 points, the bottom pipes are 1 point.

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer ball is recommended. Rumble doesn’t quite work with ball targets or player targets since the camera is too far away.

entries.name: Uplink
entries.shortDescription:
Description
The idea of this map is that there are 6 towers that you need to transfer power to the center console. Send the ball through each zone to activate the tower, and once all 6 zones are cleared, the goal opens up in the middle to score.

Recommended Settings
Time: 10+ Minutes
Score: First to 1 Goal
Boost: Unlimited

entries.name: Tetris
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Welcome to Rocket League Tetris! This standard field is one of the craziest looking maps I’ve built in a while. There are 3 goals on the back wall of Tetris blocks worth 1-3 as you go up the wall. This map has ZERO curvature, so beware of popping the ball on sharp corners (I’m kidding, but it can be rough)

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer Settings are very good

entries.name: Zelda Clock Town
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Welcome to another hide n seek map! This one is based in The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask’s Clock Town. I’ve added crates around the map to add more hiding spots, and I’ve included the basement/well of the clock tower as part of the map. You can hide anywhere you like, as long as you set the boundaries with your friends! Demo your friends to catch them!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Boost: You choose!
Demo: On Contact

entries.name: Quake Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League Quake Sumo is another addition to the Sumo series of maps I’ve made, but this one runs a little differently. Instead of only having 1 life, this is instead a Team Deathmatch mode where every time you fall off the edge, you give the other team a point on the scoreboard. Battle with your friends or 1v1 your rival and see how you do!

Recommended Settings
Time: 10 or 20 Minutes
Demo: Disabled
Rumble: Demo Derby

entries.name: Monster Truck Rally
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This SUNDAY SUNDAY SUNDAY! Come on down to the Rocket League Monster Truck Rally! Featuring tracks, hills, and a ring of fire! This is a standard Rocket League map with just 2 goals on each end, but in this case it’s 2 fiery rings. You might recognize these rings from another map of mine?

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Boomer Settings are very good

entries.name: Quicksand Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
Description
Rocket League, but with Quicksand! Welcome to another addition to the Sumo series on my site. There are 4 islands with pyramids you can climb and hide from your friends. Don’t fall into the quicksand though! This one is a ton of fun with demo derby settings (use the custom rumble plugin to customize powerups on bakkesmod)

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled
Rumble: Demo Derby or custom powerups plugin

entries.name: Medieval Jousting Sumo
entries.shortDescription:
Description
We jump into the land of medieval Rocket League, but this time around we’re jousting! This is a 1 on 1 game mode where you actually wear a giant lance as you try and knock your opponent into the water. Careful of the thin platform!

Recommended Settings
Time: Unlimited
Demo: Disabled
Rumble: Demo Derby or custom powerups plugin

entries.name: Medieval Bumperball
entries.shortDescription:
Description
This is a Medieval rendition of a custom Rocket League map made by Yoshilus. Bumperball features 3 goals on each end, but the middle is worth 6 points and resets the kickoff, meanwhile the outer 2 are only worth 1 point and give possession to the team that conceded. Give it a go with spike rush!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Rumble: Spike Rush

entries.name: Medieval Volleyball
entries.shortDescription:
This is a Medieval rendition of a custom Rocket League map made by Derzo and MrPhil. Volleyball is one of the most classic custom Rocket League maps out there, and has so many different versions. It is constantly being tweaked and improved upon, and has been for years. Enjoy this new background in a polished game mode!

Recommended Settings
Boost: Unlimited
Physics: these are you to you! This is quite a difficult map, so you can try low gravity, light ball, and any combination of bouncine...

entries.shortDescription: You may try, but you will fail.

entries.shortDescription: This is a standard spin on the mode I created called Garrison! Keep the ball in the opponent’s half to take away their HP. Test your friends’ offense!.

entries.name: The Elements
entries.shortDescription: This 6-month project combines the 4 basic “elements” into one giant map: Earth, Water, Air & Fire.

entries.name: Dacia Spring Electric Challenge
entries.shortDescription: Dacia Spring Electric Challenge is a special map created with Lethamyr, Gidek & Mr. Swaggles where you will go on a 100% electric journey. Fly through a bustling city and peaceful suburbs before entering a futuristic stadium.

Mutators: Hoops, Unlimited Boost
